title: Jungle Chess
tagline: Seven columns. Nine rows. One den.

lines.en: Seven columns. Nine rows. Two rivers.
Jungle Chess. The classic Dou Shou Qi.
Elephant, lion, tiger, rat. Rank decides who eats whom.
lines.zh: 大象、狮子、老虎、老鼠，等级决定谁能吃谁。

lines.en: Rats swim. Lions and tigers leap the river. Traps bring any animal down.
lines.zh: 老鼠会游泳，狮子老虎会跳河，陷阱能让任何动物降级。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to a three-move Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到向前算三步的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一局域网加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Jungle Chess. Enter the den, or capture them all.
lines.zh: 斗兽棋。进入兽穴，或吃光对方。
